english.title: Obstruct authorised person empowered to inspect club before grant etc of certificate - Licensing
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) obstructed a person authorised under the Licensing Act 2003 in the exercise of a power to enter and inspect club premises, namely **(..SPECIFY THE CLUB PREMISES..), an application having been made to the licensing authority, namely **(..SPECIFY THE LICENSING AUTHORITY..), for

(A)_[the grant of a club premises certificate]_
(B)_[the variation of a club premises certificate under section 84 of the Act]_
(C)_[the review of a club premises certificate under section 87 of the Act]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 96 of the Licensing Act 2003.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Any entry and inspection must take place at a reasonable time on a day not more than fourteen days after the making of the application. (Section 96(3)).
(ii) At least forty eight hours notice of an inspection must be given. (Section 96(4)).
(iii) The licensing authority may on the application of a responsible authority extend the time allowed to make the inspection by no more than seven days. (Section 96(7)).

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level two on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
12 months
